# discord_subscription (Data Source)

Lists subscriptions containing a SKU, filtered by user. Discord requires `user_id` unless querying with an OAuth token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_subscription" "user" {
  sku_id  = "333333333333333333"
  user_id = "222222222222222222"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sku_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the SKU.

### Optional

- `user_id` (String) Filter to subscriptions for this user ID (required with bot/bearer auth).

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) The matching subscriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Subscription snowflake ID.
- `sku_ids` (List of String) SKU IDs included in the subscription.
- `status` (Number) Subscription status.
- `user_id` (String) User the subscription belongs to.
